title: S. Korea, U.S. conclude multinational maritime mine warfare exercise off Busan
caption:
Fifteen nations recently joined forces off the coast of Busan for a massive mine warfare exercise. The goal was to sharpen coordination between international navies and improve harbor clearance capabilities.

Source: En - S. Korea, U.S. conclude multinational maritime mine warfare exercise off Busan
